lastCompletedStory.title: Strip the inert frontmatter model: lines from the 5 pane/root agent files (dual-copy)

openQuestions: vendor/check-agent-frontmatter.ts (vendored byte-for-byte from the upstream reporter monorepo per vendor/README.md) still lists 'model' in REQUIRED_TOP_LEVEL_KEYS. Now that all 5 templates/agents/subagent-*.md personas have no model: line, a downstream `cam init`'s runVendoredSmoke('check-agent-frontmatter.ts') step will fail this required-key check against the materialized copies. Not fixed in this story: editing the vendored file locally would violate its documented verbatim-vendoring contract (re-vendor procedure pins an upstream sha). No existing test in this repo exercises the smoke against real templates/ content, so bun test / check:all stay green despite this latent regression. Needs a follow-up: either fix upstream in reporter and re-vendor, or make a deliberate, documented local divergence dropping 'model' from REQUIRED_TOP_LEVEL_KEYS.

cam-ship.md (.claude/commands/cam-ship.md and templates/commands/cam-ship.md) still carries a model: frontmatter line and is deliberately untouched by this story per its notes field -- that file's frontmatter is documented as its own source (rewritten by mergeConfigChoices via FRONTMATTER_TARGET_PHASE_PATHS['ship']), out of scope here, presumably handled by US-003.
nextStoryContext: US-002 removed the `model:` YAML frontmatter line entirely (not replaced with a comment) from all 5 dual-copy persona files: .claude/agents/subagent-{orchestrator,planner,auditor,reviewer,implementer}.md and templates/agents/subagent-{same}.md. Verified via source read (plan-runner.ts, plan-argv.ts, review.ts, worker-argv.ts, run.ts) that all five roles are actually spawned with `--model <readPhaseModel(phase)>` as a claude CLI flag -- the frontmatter model: line was confirmed dead for all five, not just implementer/reviewer as an older comment in src/templates/frontmatter.ts implies (that comment, describing planner/auditor as 'Task subagents' with no --model, is now stale: plan-argv.ts shows they run as pane workers with --model too, same as implementer/reviewer). Chose plain removal over a `#`-comment replacement because vendor/check-agent-frontmatter.ts's hand-rolled frontmatter parser has zero support for comment lines and would hard-error on one. `bun run embed-vendor` was re-run (src/vendor/_generated.ts regenerated) since templates/ changed; embed-vendor:check, typecheck, bun test (4343 pass), and check:all (test/embed-vendor/lint/file-size/debt-markers/version-skips/coverage/dead-code/dup/ci-parity) all passed clean. Left cam-ship.md's frontmatter untouched per this story's own notes (presumably US-003's scope). Two follow-ups recorded in openQuestions above: the vendor smoke's now-stale REQUIRED_TOP_LEVEL_KEYS mismatch (deliberately not patched -- verbatim-vendoring invariant), and the src/templates/frontmatter.ts docstring/FRONTMATTER_TARGET_PHASE_PATHS mechanism for planner/auditor being effectively as inert as the frontmatter it rewrites (since --model already wins for those two roles too) -- neither is required by this story's AC, so neither was touched.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure internal markdown/YAML-frontmatter edit across agent persona files; no external library API surface was exercised.
